achievements.name: Hello World
achievements.description: Clear stage 1 on either side in story mode.

achievements.name: Chao!
achievements.description: Name your Chao for the first time.

achievements.name: Chao Raiser
achievements.description: Raise all 5 properties of any one Chao up to level 10.

achievements.name: HERO!
achievements.description: Clear HERO side in story mode.

achievements.name: DARK!
achievements.description: Clear DARK side in story mode.

achievements.name: Boss Attack
achievements.description: Clear all 3 modes in Boss Attack Mode.

achievements.name: Mission Complete
achievements.description: Win all A RANKs (5 A RANKs) in any one stage in story mode.

achievements.name: Heaven or Hell
achievements.description: Raise a HERO Chao and a DARK Chao with your hero and dark characters respectively.

achievements.name: Beyond Good And Evil
achievements.description: Clear LAST part in story mode.

achievements.name: Speedy Racer
achievements.description: Win NO.1 in expert level in kart race.

achievements.name: Emblem Collector
achievements.description: Unlock 90 emblems.

achievements.name: You Are The Legend
achievements.description: Win A RANK in all stages in Story Mode.

achievements.name: Level 4!
achievements.description: Play all level 4 stages in Action Race, Treasure Hunter and Shooting Battle.

achievements.name: Karate Master
achievements.description: Beat all your enemies in Super Level in Chao Karate 1P mode.

achievements.name: Emblem Mania
achievements.description: Unlock all 180 emblems.
